item.title: Blue Jays vs Mariners: Surprising Split That Shifted the AL West
item.description:
How does a team go from being shut out 2-0 to hanging up 11 runs the very next day? That is exactly the whiplash that defined the latest Blue Jays vs Mariners meeting in Seattle over the July 4th weekend.

The series swung from a tight pitcher’s duel to a lopsided blowout in less than 24 hours — and the ripple effects reached all the way to the top of the AL West standings.

item.title: Josh Naylor's Surprising Slow Start: Why the Mariners Shouldn't Panic Yet
item.description:
A .104 batting average from your $92.5 million offseason centerpiece is enough to make any fanbase reach for the panic button. But what if the numbers hiding beneath that ugly surface tell a completely different story?

That is exactly the situation unfolding with Josh Naylor and the Seattle Mariners in the early weeks of the 2026 MLB season. And on April 13, Naylor may have fired the first shot of a turnaround, launching a homer against the Houston Astros that scored Cal Raleigh and Julio Rodriguez in a much-needed offensive burst.
